description: This file defines an Android activity 'CameraPreview' that manages camera preview functionality, including switching between cameras, and includes a nested 'Preview' class handling the camera preview display and configuration.

classes.name: CameraPreview
classes.description: An Android Activity that manages camera preview, including switching cameras and handling camera lifecycle.

classes.name: Preview
classes.description: A custom ViewGroup that manages the SurfaceView for camera preview, including optimal size calculations and reconfiguration during camera switching.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the camera, and finds available cameras.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Opens the default camera and associates it with the preview.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Releases the camera resources when activity is paused.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the menu for camera options, such as switching cameras.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu actions, like switching between cameras.

methods.name: setCamera
methods.description: Assigns a Camera object to the Preview view and updates supported sizes.

methods.name: switchCamera
methods.description: Switches to a different camera and updates the preview display.

methods.name: onMeasure
methods.description: Determines the size of the preview surface, selecting the optimal preview size.

methods.name: onLayout
methods.description: Centers and sizes the SurfaceView within the parent layout.

methods.name: surfaceCreated
methods.description: Callback when the surface is created; sets the camera preview display.

methods.name: surfaceDestroyed
methods.description: Callback when the surface is destroyed; stops the camera preview.

methods.name: surfaceChanged
methods.description: Handles surface size changes by adjusting camera parameters.

methods.name: getOptimalPreviewSize
methods.description: Selects the most suitable preview size based on aspect ratio and dimensions.
